summary.text: Steven Kelly is a Republican state representative from Montana House District 9 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience includes law enforcement, and he serves on the House Judiciary and Human Services committees.

paragraphs.text: Steven Kelly was born in San Luis Obispo, California, attended Lassen County Community College and Blue Mountain Community College, and earned a graduate degree from the University of Phoenix in 2010.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as law enforcement and his affiliations as the Flathead County Republican Central Committee, the Flathead Valley Clay Target Club and Back Country Horseman of the Flathead.
Kelly won the Republican primary for District 9 in 2024, defeating Lee Huestis, and then defeated Democrat Joanne Morrow in the general election.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the Human Services Committee.
He advanced unopposed from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Kate McLaughlin in the general election.
